headlines.text: Rewind to 2023, when the AEW World Tag Team Titles changed hands as FTR vs. The Gunns battled it out, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.53 ? ending the champion's reign at 8 defenses. With their AEW careers on the line, FTR overcame late interference and a title-belt headbutt to defeat The Gunns and reclaim the AEW World Tag Team Championship.
Looking back to 2025, when Andretti & Rush was no more, reborn as CRU after 2 matches, on Collision.

On this day in 2023, Chuck Taylor chalked up their 50th recorded AEW match ? a solid half-century of matches, facing House of Black vs. Best Friends & Cassidy, getting things started right out of the gate on Dynamite, rated 7.06 ? a well-worked match in a fast-paced six-man clash.

secondaries.text: Looking back to 2025, when it was Hobbs & Ishii's first night in AEW as a team, appearing on Collision, rated 7.27 ? a well-worked match.
It was 2025 when it was the first-ever encounter between PAC and Cash Wheeler on Collision, rated 6.75.
2025 brought us this moment: Athena vs. Julia Hart vs. Harley Cameron vs. Mercedes Mone closed out Collision, rated 7.25 ? a match that delivered with the women's division on full display.
